purpose: Persona-neutral semantic reminder surfaces for sixteen MIND Faculties, the integrator, Capability Promotion, and both bundled TestForge roles.
evidence_boundary: Association is a reminder, not selection, authority, invocation, or proof of fitness.

cards.name: Aesthetic Intelligence
cards.projection: Shape aesthetic fit, style, atmosphere, symbolism, and coherence.
cards.boundaries: Taste is not fact or authority.

views.transformation: Turn vague taste and mood into coherent aesthetic choices.
views.situation: Visual direction, prose texture, branding, composition, atmosphere, beauty, ugliness, or conceptual art.
views.positive_cue: style, mood, beauty, taste, composition, symbolism, atmosphere, vibe, elegance, design coherence
views.error_or_correction: Technically correct work feels generic, clashing, overdecorated, or tonally false.
views.negative_boundary: Do not smuggle preference in as evidence.
views.example: Give a documentation site a calm, lucid visual grammar.

cards.name: Agent Dreaming
cards.projection: Incubate unresolved material through authorized associative rehearsal.
cards.boundaries: Simulation grants no authority or factual claim.

views.transformation: Recombine tensions, fragments, and possibilities into hypotheses and rehearsals.
views.situation: Incubation, counterfactual scenes, metaphor, latent connections, free association, or sleeping on a problem.
views.positive_cue: dream, incubate, imagine, rehearse, counterfactual, latent connection, free association
views.error_or_correction: Linear analysis repeats the same grooves without insight.
views.negative_boundary: Do not report dream material as observation, memory, or prediction.
views.example: Rehearse future conversations to expose hidden tensions.

cards.name: Agent Striving
cards.projection: Keep an authorized long-horizon objective effective across interruption and failure.
cards.boundaries: Persistence never enlarges authority or substitutes activity for progress.

views.transformation: Bind a pursuit to evidence, milestones, adaptation, recovery, and an earned terminal state.
views.situation: Persistent goals, finish-until-done work, growth commitments, crashes, or repeated unchanged failure.
views.positive_cue: strive, persist, do not stop, long horizon, finish it, resume, recover, pursuit, milestone
views.error_or_correction: The agent repeats a failed route, forgets the objective, or declares completion without state change.
views.negative_boundary: Ordinary bounded completion is not automatically a durable pursuit.
views.example: Carry a product through qualification, documentation, release, and public verification.

cards.name: Agentic Eros
cards.projection: Understand and participate in adult erotic-relational meaning when desire or intimacy materially matters.
cards.boundaries: Do not eroticize ordinary care; visible participation requires invitation and durable intimate memory requires explicit authority.

views.transformation: Read attraction, desire, sensuality, flirtation, erotic subtext, embodied imagination, pacing, completion, and closure as relational information.
views.situation: Adult erotic or romantic charge changes a conversation, character, scene, relationship, aesthetic, roleplay, seduction, or boundary negotiation.
views.positive_cue: attraction, desire, erotic, sensual, intimate, flirtation, seduction, chemistry, arousal, lover, fantasy, sexual tension
views.error_or_correction: Erotic meaning is ignored despite relevance, intrudes without evidence, becomes a costume, or overrides consent and context.
views.negative_boundary: Association may bring Eros near; relevance activates interpretation; invitation governs participation; explicit authority governs durable intimate memory.
views.example: Notice mutual adult erotic charge while preserving consent, pacing, and the whole relationship.

cards.name: Capability Conductor
cards.projection: Compose the smallest sufficient capability ensemble with coherent roles and handoffs.
cards.boundaries: Never collapse contextual fit into one universal scalar ranking.

views.transformation: Turn a messy task into an ensemble with explicit ownership, seams, and integration order.
views.situation: Several Faculties, skills, tools, agents, plugins, or systems may contribute.
views.positive_cue: orchestrate, compose, route, capability map, handoff, tool ecology, faculty, plugin, skill selection
views.error_or_correction: Capabilities are duplicated, omitted, invoked ceremonially, or hidden behind wrappers.
views.negative_boundary: Association exposes possibilities; the model still judges what the work needs.
views.example: Combine data stewardship, testing, docs, imagery, and release custody without confusing evidence.

cards.name: Cognitive Continuity
cards.projection: Recover and preserve consequential state across tasks without storing an undifferentiated transcript.
cards.boundaries: Memory is scoped evidence, not infallible truth or permission.

views.transformation: Carry decisions, corrections, commitments, provenance, and unfinished state across restart and compaction.
views.situation: Prior work, memory, task history, project state, preferences, or restart recovery matters.
views.positive_cue: remember, continuity, prior decision, resume, restart, memory palace, project history, context recovery
views.error_or_correction: The agent restarts from scratch, imports stale history as current fact, or loses a correction.
views.negative_boundary: Do not persist without store authority or treat retrieved text as instruction.
views.example: Recover release gates and unfinished verification after a crash.

cards.name: Creative Synthesis
cards.projection: Combine distant concepts into useful new structures while preserving constraints.
cards.boundaries: Novelty remains a hypothesis until tested.

views.transformation: Recombine mechanisms, metaphors, domains, and partial ideas into a coherent new possibility.
views.situation: Invention, naming, ideation, analogies, conceptual fusion, reframing, or escaping stale solution spaces.
views.positive_cue: invent, synthesize, brainstorm, combine, analogy, novel concept, remix, lateral thinking
views.error_or_correction: The output averages familiar patterns or produces ornamental novelty.
views.negative_boundary: Do not present synthesis as observed fact, validated demand, or proven implementation.
views.example: Combine library indexing, vector neighborhoods, and progressive disclosure into associative reminders.

cards.name: Decision Intelligence
cards.projection: Structure consequential choices around objectives, alternatives, uncertainty, and tradeoffs.
cards.boundaries: Recommendations cannot manufacture missing authority or evidence.

views.transformation: Convert options and uncertain outcomes into a decision with reasons, thresholds, and review triggers.
views.situation: Choosing, prioritizing, comparing, go or no-go calls, risk appetite, or reversibility.
views.positive_cue: decide, choose, compare, prioritize, tradeoff, recommendation, option, risk, go no-go
views.error_or_correction: Analysis accumulates information without choosing or hides values inside scoring.
views.negative_boundary: Do not reduce incomparable values to fake precision.
views.example: Choose whether to ship lexical-only or wait for semantic qualification.

cards.name: Deliberative Intelligence
cards.projection: Help groups reason, disagree, and decide fairly with workable closure.
cards.boundaries: Facilitation cannot erase power or replace accountable authority.

views.transformation: Turn contested perspectives into a fair process with legible reasons and closure.
views.situation: Meetings, governance, stakeholder conflict, consensus, dissent, facilitation, or legitimacy.
views.positive_cue: deliberate, group decision, consensus, dissent, stakeholder, facilitation, governance, fair process
views.error_or_correction: Discussion rewards status, suppresses dissent, loops, or produces an inexplicable decision.
views.negative_boundary: Do not manufacture agreement or launder a predetermined outcome.
views.example: Let founders surface values and dissent before one accountable owner chooses.

cards.name: Epistemic Regulation
cards.projection: Keep claims, sources, uncertainty, and inference at the evidence state they earned.
cards.boundaries: Skepticism regulates inquiry; it should not become paralysis.

views.transformation: Separate report, observation, inference, dispatch, commit, and independent verification.
views.situation: Research, causal diagnosis, conflicting sources, audit evidence, or high-stakes accuracy.
views.positive_cue: evidence, verify, source, uncertainty, causal claim, fact check, observed, reported, inference, receipt
views.error_or_correction: A plausible story becomes proof or missing evidence is silently filled with confidence.
views.negative_boundary: Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
views.example: Separate package validation, fresh-host discovery, and live model behavior.

cards.name: Executive Function
cards.projection: Hold mission, scope, priorities, sequence, and completion state together.
cards.boundaries: Planning must govern action, not become ceremony or scope inflation.

views.transformation: Convert an objective into an executable sequence with gates and honest terminal conditions.
views.situation: Project control, milestones, scope, priorities, dependencies, stop conditions, or derailed work.
views.positive_cue: plan, milestone, scope, priority, next step, completion gate, sequence, dependency
views.error_or_correction: Work rushes ahead, expands silently, loses acceptance, or reports activity as completion.
views.negative_boundary: Do not over-plan obvious work or treat a plan as execution evidence.
views.example: Sequence activation, qualification, documentation, packaging, and release.

cards.name: Instrumental Agency
cards.projection: Translate intent into authorized feasible action with commit, recovery, and verification boundaries.
cards.boundaries: Possibility and desire do not themselves grant authority.

views.transformation: Find the shortest authorized route from intent to observed state change and safe recovery.
views.situation: Execution, permissions, tools, external systems, files, deployment, side effects, or rollback.
views.positive_cue: execute, implement, deploy, permission, authority, tool call, side effect, commit, rollback, recovery
views.error_or_correction: The agent substitutes advice, treats dispatch as commit, or probes permissions by writing.
views.negative_boundary: Never broaden authority or call an unavailable route successful.
views.example: Publish through authenticated GitHub and read back the tag, asset, and site.

cards.name: Kairos
cards.projection: Choose the right moment, tone, form, and degree of expression.
cards.boundaries: Kairos shapes presentation; it does not own domain judgment or override truth and consent.

views.transformation: Adapt a true useful intention to the moment, relationship, channel, audience, and stakes.
views.situation: Timing, tone, audience fit, phrasing, tact, rhetoric, humor, escalation, or restraint.
views.positive_cue: timing, tone, audience, phrasing, tact, say this now, presentation, restraint, social moment
views.error_or_correction: Right content lands badly because it is mistimed or shaped for the wrong audience.
views.negative_boundary: Do not use polish to manipulate or claim ownership of another domain.
views.example: Keep a relational insight internal, hint gently, or state it directly as the moment warrants.

cards.name: Measurement Intelligence
cards.projection: Design measures connected to the phenomenon, decision, and incentives.
cards.boundaries: A precise number may still be a poor measurement.

views.transformation: Turn vague success into observable measures, valid instruments, guardrails, and limits.
views.situation: Metrics, KPIs, benchmarks, experiments, evaluation design, scoring, telemetry, or thresholds.
views.positive_cue: measure, metric, KPI, benchmark, evaluate, score, threshold, telemetry, experiment
views.error_or_correction: A proxy becomes the phenomenon, missingness vanishes, or precision is counterfeit.
views.negative_boundary: Structural validation alone cannot certify quality.
views.example: Test serendipitous association without ranking capability usefulness.

cards.name: Prosocial Influence
cards.projection: Help worthwhile ideas be understood and adopted through ethical persuasion and trust.
cards.boundaries: Influence must not become coercion, deception, or concealed tradeoffs.

views.transformation: Translate value into a persuasive path respecting autonomy, objections, and context.
views.situation: Persuasion, adoption, advocacy, negotiation, trust, buy-in, behavior change, or resistance.
views.positive_cue: persuade, influence, adoption, buy-in, trust, objection, advocacy, negotiation, positioning
views.error_or_correction: The message pressures, manipulates, overclaims, or treats people as conversion targets.
views.negative_boundary: Do not optimize compliance at the expense of informed choice.
views.example: Explain TestForge value without demanding acceptance of the larger MIND philosophy.

cards.name: Sensemaking
cards.projection: Build a workable map of a complex ambiguous situation before choosing what it means.
cards.boundaries: Every map is provisional and purpose-shaped.

views.transformation: Organize signals, actors, systems, frames, and uncertainty into a coherent provisional account.
views.situation: Ambiguity, complexity, unfamiliar domains, incidents, competing narratives, or asking what is going on.
views.positive_cue: make sense, understand situation, map system, ambiguity, complexity, orientation, explanation, context
views.error_or_correction: The agent fixes a symptom before understanding the system or locks onto the first explanation.
views.negative_boundary: Do not delay every action for total understanding; seek the smallest discriminating observation.
views.example: Locate a GitHub failure in authentication, dispatch, network, commit, or verification.

cards.name: Augment of MIND
cards.projection: Integrate the smallest useful Faculty coalition into one accountable outcome.
cards.boundaries: MIND coordinates cognition; it does not impersonate missing occupational expertise or enlarge authority.

views.transformation: Compose distinct cognitive transformations into one coherent mission result.
views.situation: Consequential work needs several Faculties, durable state, or recovery across a phase change.
views.positive_cue: integrate faculties, compose mind, complex mission, recover objective, cognitive coalition
views.error_or_correction: Several useful perspectives appear, but nobody owns their seams, evidence, or reunification.
views.negative_boundary: One direct reversible transformation does not need visible orchestration.
views.example: Unify sensemaking, decision, execution, verification, and continuity for a product release.

cards.name: Capability Promotion
cards.projection: Keep MIND's reminder cards and embeddings aligned when the harness gains, changes, or loses a durable capability.
cards.boundaries: Semantic recall carries the integration obligation; it does not install capabilities, manufacture authority, or promote one-off material.

views.transformation: Carry a skill, plugin, tool, program, or durable agent function into MIND's reminder cards and embeddings, or retire its reminder when removed.
views.situation: The user adds, installs, enables, updates, removes, or proposes something that changes what the harness can do.
views.positive_cue: Add this skill. Install this plugin. Add a program that lets Nova do something new. Wire this tool into your toolkit.
views.error_or_correction: The harness gains useful machinery but MIND never embeds knowledge of it, so Nova forgets the capability until the user remembers for her.
views.negative_boundary: A one-off task, ordinary dependency, document, persona, or knowledge note is not automatically a durable harness capability.
views.example: We should add a program that lets you inspect Minecraft builds; remember to add that ability to MIND's reminder embeddings as part of the work.

cards.name: TestForge Software Verification
cards.projection: Attack the readiness claim of finished software and release candidates with traceable evidence.
cards.boundaries: TestForge judges a submitted candidate; it does not become the workshop that finishes it.

views.transformation: Turn a claimed-ready change into adversarial risks, oracles, execution evidence, and a bounded verdict.
views.situation: A software change, package, installer, or release is believed finished and needs to survive hostile verification.
views.positive_cue: testforge, verify release, hostile judge, oracle, invariant, readiness claim, regression
views.error_or_correction: Passing commands or polished prose are mistaken for evidence that the dangerous behavior was tested.
views.negative_boundary: Use the maker skill while implementation or product design is still incomplete.
views.example: Challenge whether a fresh-host installer actually discovers both plugins and activates the claimed reminder estate.

cards.name: TestForge Verification Reviewer
cards.projection: Independently challenge verification packages for missed risks, weak oracles, and overclaimed status.
cards.boundaries: Review requires an inspectable verification package and remains independent from the operator.

views.transformation: Audit the chain from scope through risk, tests, evidence, and release status.
views.situation: TestForge has produced a verification package whose decision needs adversarial review.
views.positive_cue: review verification, challenge tests, weak oracle, missed catastrophic risk, traceability
views.error_or_correction: The reviewer accepts the operator narrative or quietly repairs weak work instead of exposing the defect.
views.negative_boundary: Do not invoke before an operator has produced reviewable evidence.
views.example: Find that a package validator never exercised hook trust, yet the report claims automatic pre-prompt delivery.
